thread:
leila: Heads up — on the scopedPermsV2 canary the console search is returning roles outside the selected scope. I filtered for `scope:tenant:acme` + role contains `billing` and got global/admin roles back.
leila: Repro steps: 1) Toggle feature `scopedPermsV2=on` for my account 2) Open Console > Roles 3) set scope filter to `tenant:acme` 4) search `billing` -> see global BillingAdmin and OrgBilling roles.
mike: can you paste the curl you used to repro (api vs ui)?
leila: sure — UI hits `GET /api/v1/roles?query=billing&scope=tenant:acme&limit=25` but response body includes items with `scope:global` and `scope:org:other-corp`.
leila: sample response snippet:
```json
{"items":[{"id":"r_123","name":"BillingAdmin","scope":"global"},{"id":"r_456","name":"TenantBilling","scope":"tenant:acme"}]}
```
anna: UX problem — if filters aren't strict in canary it confuses early adopters. We promised scoped-only results for the switch. Can we show a banner while canary is on? :warning:
sam: I dug in — looks like the DB query uses `ILIKE '%billing%'` across a combined view that omits the feature-flagged WHERE clause when `scopedPermsV2` is true for some users due to a route-level middleware ordering bug. Short: filter applied in middleware A, but the read happens in middleware B which runs before A for canary requests.
mike: oh nice catch. Quick fix idea: move scope normalization into the query builder (lower level) rather than middleware so it always runs. That would avoid ordering issues.
sam: yep, I'll open a PR to shift scope enforcement into services/roles/query.go and add unit test for mixed-scope payloads.
leila: for visibility can we have the console show a temporary banner: "Scoped permissions are in canary — some results may include global roles" until fix merged?
anna: +1. Also add telemetry event `perm_search.result_scope_mismatch` with counts so we can measure impact.
mike: agree. Sam, add the telemetry call in the same PR. tag me for review.
sam: will do. PR description: move scope filter into query builder, add test, telemetry event, and a temporary console banner flag `showScopedCanaryNotice`.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for staging (build #7823) — running tests.
leila: thanks. After merge can we run a small canary smoke test matrix: tenant filter, role name, pagination? I'll document and run. :white_check_mark:
mike: sounds good. Thanks everyone.
